Philadelphia

during the current Beige Book period – still below levels 
attained prior to the pandemic. Supply constraints contin-
ued to limit growth but may also be contributing to overstat-
ed perceptions of strong demand for labor and parts. Em-
ployment continued to grow modestly as did wage growth, 
while prices grew moderately.
